description: Elections Commission - Elections Commission Order under Article 98(8) of the Constitution
reasoning: This gazette content is about electoral processes, specifically certifying the number of members each electoral district is entitled to return based on the certified Electoral Register for 2022. It is issued by the Election Commission under constitutional authority (Article 98(8)) and contains a schedule listing electoral districts with their corresponding number of representatives. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral boundary changes, election-related certifications, and electoral commission decisions.
